detection_scope.ruling: PI ruling D50, 2026-10-07 (planning/pi-decisions-2026-09-20.md): detections are scoped per sheet by tile geometry, as references are, each attributed to its origin sheet and never re-keyed to another sheet. Option (A) of reports/frames-blast-radius-2026-10-07.md § 6.

spatial.geojson_storage_note: GeoJSON is WGS84 (RFC 7946) unless a file declares its own crs member; the scorer reprojects to evaluation_crs before matching.
